description: A library of single pass algorithms for statistical measures.
releaseNotes:
Changes since 3.3.0:
			- `EmpiricalCdf`: `Fit(value, count)` batches a constant run instead of replaying it one observation at a time. The cost is now O(count / NumBins) flush blends plus O(NumBins) boundary work, down from O(count). The resulting state stays bitwise identical to a loop of single fits, so no released result changes (issue #8)
			- `EmpiricalCdf`: `Cdf` binary searches its sorted window instead of scanning it; same results (PR #11)
			- `Histogram`: bin lookup is a binary search over the constructor's sorted, distinct, NaN-free edges instead of a per-observation scan; same results (PR #11)
			- `Histogram`: `Merge`'s mismatched-shape branch now counts the source's out-of-bounds bins into `Nobs`, restoring the count identity `Nobs = bins + counters`; bug fix, no new behavior (PR #11)
			- `Sum`, `Mean`: folds run through a branch-free Knuth two-sum, so canceling streams at kappa >= 1e14 return the exact total/mean instead of zero; batch `Fit(iterable)` folds once and commits state only after validation, bit-identical to the two-pass path (PR #11)
			- `Normal`: the mean/variance update is inlined instead of delegating to `Mean`/`Variance` objects; state stays bit-identical on both routes (PR #11)
			- `Mean`, `Normal`, `Variance`: hot-path blends at call sites whose weight is provably a count ratio in (0, 1] use `Utils.SmoothUnchecked`; the arithmetic expression is unchanged, so state bits do not move (PR #11)
			Changes since 3.2.0:
			- `CountMap`: `CloneEmpty` now propagates the map's comparer (previously the clone dropped a custom comparer and fell back to the default one, so `MinKey`/`MaxKey` and merging on a cloned map used wrong key order — issue #6)
			- `Beta`: `Median` existence relaxed from `Successes` > 1 and `Failures` > 1 to at least one success and at least one failure (`Quantile(0.5)` now defined for e.g. 1/1 fits instead of returning NaN); `Mode` still requires > 1 of each
			- `Moments`: replaced raw power-sum accumulation with a numerically stable Chan/Welford central-moment update; Skewness/Kurtosis near large offsets are now accurate (~1e-12 relative to spread-scaled tolerance) instead of garbage, and fitting is ~1.6x faster (same public surface)
			- `Variance`: switched to a two-pass population variance, eliminating catastrophic cancellation for data at large offsets
			- `EmpiricalCdf`: `Merge` no longer blends unflushed buffer slots as zeros (phantom-zero bias removed); `Quantile`/`Cdf` now reject NaN probabilities
			- `Beta`: `Variance` getter computes its numerator in `double`, fixing `long` product wraparound at counts near 3.1e9
			- `Sum` (generic): batch-fitting fallback now accumulates in O(log count) via doubling instead of a linear loop
			- `Normal`: `Fit(iterable)` with an empty collection is now a clean no-op instead of throwing
			- `Histogram`: the constructor now rejects NaN, duplicate and non-monotonic edge values with `ArgumentException` instead of silently sorting them
			- Input-validation contract: `Fit(iterable)` throws `ArgumentNullException` for null collections (was `NullReferenceException` deep in the loop), `Extrema` rejects null observations, and observation counters are accumulated in checked blocks — `OverflowException` instead of silent wraparound
title: Running Statistics
